answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 22929 Country: India Title: I am affected one side headache since four yeras. i have taken treatment from homeopathetic and unani medicine. But the pain is again coming. Kindly tell me any duwa for healing the one side headache? Question: I am affected one side headache since four yeras. i have taken treatment from homeopathetic and unani medicine. But the pain is again coming. Kindly tell me any duwa for healing the one side headache? Answer ID: 22929 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1073/873/B=1431) Put your hand on the place of headache and recite the following dua seven times: أسأل الله العظيم ، رب العرش العظيم ان يشفيني Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
